name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical system?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider upgrading my bathroom's electrical system?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider upgrading your bathroom's electrical system if you experience frequent tripped breakers, flickering lights, or if your outlets feel warm to the touch. These are signs of an overloaded or outdated system. Additionally, if your home is older and has knob-and-tube or aluminum wiring, an upgrade is highly recommended for safety. Any major bathroom remodel is also an opportune time to update the electrical to meet current codes and your modern needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrade your bathroom's electrical if you have frequent tripped breakers, flickering lights, warm outlets, outdated wiring, or during a major remodel.
